{{Quote|We can get there on Transit Yellow. Four stops.|Tru Veld to Ferus Olin and Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Dangerous Game">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>}}
'''Transit Yellow''' was a transportation route in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]], [[Euceron]]. The route had at least five stops, and was used by the [[Padawan/Legends|padawans]] [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]], [[Ferus Olin]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] to make their way to [[Stadium One]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
